notes: Second isnad: «قال فذكرته لإبراهيم فحدثني إبراهيم عن أبي عبيدة ... بمثله سواء» is a second route with the same saying, so it is a second group; both end at Zaynab, so the names repeat and the tail is null (rule 3)

Ruling needed: the speaker of «قال فذكرته لإبراهيم» ('I mentioned it to Ibrahim') is not named in the text; the reader places him as al-A'mash from the chain above, which the text does not write (rule 11, implicit first-person transmission). The second group is built on that reading
Zaynab relates the Prophet's answer: the Prophet is not a link, so she is the last
The story of Zaynab and Abdullah's wife inside the saying is scene, not a link; «إبراهيم» first appears as «لإبراهيم», so the chain's own mention is the second occurrence
